technical-summary: RCS13 (#946): the remote-MoE GEMV kernels use launch-sized dynamic LDS instead of fixed K<=2560 arrays; each stage's actual K and the device LDS limit are checked before launch with a pure per-variant calculator; the grouped GEMM is the fallback and a launch failure fails closed; both model-constant guard allowances are removed. K=2560 outputs are byte-identical and an end-to-end A/B/B/A (run 12) shows no attributable decode or prefill change. gfx1100/gfx1030 parity and a model with intermediate above 2560 remain open on the plan item.
user-summary-candidate: Remote-MoE GEMV kernels no longer silently do nothing when a model's intermediate size exceeds 2560.
